:::{#exr-bias-exprs}
#### Bias in terms of the expectation

Write the [bias](#def-bias) $\bias{\hth}$ of an estimator $\hth$
in terms of its expected value $\E{\hth}$ and the estimand $\theta$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bias-exprs}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\bias{\hth}
&\eqdef \E{\erf{\hth}}
&& \text{(definition of bias)}\\
&= \E{\hth - \theta}
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= \E{\hth} - \E{\theta}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)}\\
&= \E{\hth} - \theta
&& \text{($\theta$ is a constant)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
